phrases.def: 发展中国家发展中国家

sentences.en: Children in developing countries are healthier and more likely to survive past the age of five when their mothers can read and write.
sentences.zh: 发展中国家的儿童更健康,如果母亲能读写,则更有可能活到5岁。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Experts in public health accepted this idea decades ago, but until now no one has been able to show that a woman’s ability to read in itself improves her children’s chances of survival.
sentences.zh: 公共卫生专家在几十年前接受了这一想法,但迄今为止,没有人能够证明妇女阅读能力本身会改善子女的生存机会。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Most literate women learnt to read in primary school, and the fact that a woman has had an education may simply indicate her family’s wealth or that it values its children more highly.
sentences.zh: 大多数识字妇女在小学学习阅读,妇女受过教育的事实可能只是表明她家庭的财富,或者说她更重视孩子。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Now a long-term study carried out in Nicaragua has eliminated these factors by showing that teaching reading to poor adult women, who would otherwise have remained illiterate, has a direct effect on their children’s health and survival.
sentences.zh: 现在尼加拉瓜进行的一项长期研究已经消除了这些因素,显示对贫穷成年妇女的教学阅读对其子女的健康和生存有直接影响,否则她们本会仍然是文盲。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: In 1979, the government of Nicaragua established a number of social programmes, including a National Literacy Crusade.
sentences.zh: 1979年,尼加拉瓜政府制定了一些社会方案,包括全国扫盲十字军。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: By 1985, about 300,000 illiterate adults from all over the country, many of whom had never attended primary school, had learnt how to read, write and use numbers.
sentences.zh: 到1985年,全国约有30万文盲成人,其中许多从未上过小学,他们学会了读、写和使用数字。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

words.def: 文盲文盲文盲文盲文盲文盲文盲文盲文盲文盲文盲文盲文盲文盲文盲文盲文盲文盲文盲文盲

sentences.en: During this period, researchers from the Liverpool School of Tropical Medicine, the Central American Institute of Health in Nicaragua, the National Autonomous University of Nicaragua and the Costa Rican Institute of Health interviewed nearly 3,000 women, some of whom had learnt to read as children, some during the literacy crusade and some who had never learnt at all.
sentences.zh: 在此期间,利物浦热带医学学院、尼加拉瓜中美洲卫生研究所、尼加拉瓜国立自治大学和哥斯达黎加卫生研究所的研究人员采访了近3 000名妇女,其中一些人学会了儿童读书,有些是在扫盲运动期间,有些根本没有学会读书。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 分词结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: The women were asked how many children they had given birth to and how many of them had died in infancy.
sentences.zh: 询问这些妇女生育了多少子女,其中多少人在婴儿时死亡。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The research teams also examined the surviving children to find out how well-nourished they were.
sentences.zh: 研究小组还检查了幸存儿童,以了解他们的营养状况。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The investigators’ findings were striking.
sentences.zh: 调查人员的调查结果令人吃惊。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: In the late 1970s, the infant mortality rate for the children of illiterate mothers was around 110 deaths per thousand live births.
sentences.zh: 1970年代末期,文盲母亲子女的婴儿死亡率约为每千名活产110例死亡。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: At this point in their lives, those mothers who later went on to learn to read had a similar level of child mortality (105/1000).
sentences.zh: 在他们生命的这一时刻,那些后来继续学习阅读的母亲的儿童死亡率也差不多(105/1000)。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: For women educated in primary school, however, the infant mortality rate was significantly lower, at 80 per thousand.
sentences.zh: 然而,在小学接受教育的妇女的婴儿死亡率要低得多,为80%.。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: In 1985, after the National Literacy Crusade had ended, the infant mortality figures for those who remained illiterate and for those educated in primary school remained more or less unchanged.
sentences.zh: 1985年,在国家扫盲十字军结束后,那些文盲和小学教育的婴儿死亡率基本保持不变。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: For those women who learnt to read through the campaign, the infant mortality rate was 84 per thousand, an impressive 21 points lower than for those women who were still illiterate.
sentences.zh: 对于那些通过运动学会阅读的妇女来说,婴儿死亡率为84‰,比那些仍然文盲的妇女低21个百分点,令人印象深刻。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The children of the newly-literate mothers were also better nourished than those of women who could not read.
sentences.zh: 新识字母亲的子女也比不识字妇女的子女营养更好。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: Why are the children of literate mothers better off?
sentences.zh: 为什么识字母亲的子女生活得更好?

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: According to Peter Sandiford of the Liverpool School of Tropical Medicine, no one knows for certain.
sentences.zh: 据利物浦热带医学学校的Peter Sandiford说,没有人知道有一定的热带医学。

grammar.type: 分词结构 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Child health was not on the curriculum during the women’s lessons, so he and his colleagues are looking at other factors.
sentences.zh: 妇女上课期间,儿童保健没有列入课程,因此他和他的同事正在研究其他因素。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: They are working with the same group of 3,000 women, to try to find out whether reading mothers make better use of hospitals and clinics, opt for smaller families, exert more control at home, learn modem childcare techniques more quickly, or whether they merely have more respect for themselves and their children.
sentences.zh: 她们与3 000名妇女同一批人合作,试图了解阅读母亲是否更好地利用医院和诊所,选择较小家庭,在家里更多地控制,更快地学习调制解调器儿童保育技术,或者她们是否只是更尊重自己和子女。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The Nicaraguan study may have important implications for governments and aid agencies that need to know where to direct their resources.
sentences.zh: 尼加拉瓜的研究可能对需要知道如何引导资源方向的各国政府和援助机构产生重大影响。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Sandiford says that there is increasing evidence that female education, at any age, is ‘an important health intervention in its own right’.
sentences.zh: 桑迪福德表示,越来越多的证据表明,女性教育无论在任何年龄,都是“对自身健康的重要干预”。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The results of the study lend support to the World Bank’s recommendation that education budgets in developing countries should be increased, not just to help their economies, but also to improve child health.
sentences.zh: 研究结果支持世界银行的建议,即发展中国家应增加教育预算,不仅是为了帮助其经济,而且是为了改善儿童健康。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

words.def: 结果结果结果结果结果

sentences.en: ‘We’ve known for a long time that maternal education is important,’ says John Cleland of the London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine.
sentences.zh: 伦敦卫生和热带医学学校的John Cleland表示:「我们早就知道, 产妇教育很重要。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: ‘But we thought that even if we started educating girls today, we’d have to wait a generation for the pay-off. The Nicaraguan study suggests we may be able to bypass that.’
sentences.zh: 尼加拉瓜的研究显示,我们可以绕过这一点。 尼加拉瓜的研究表明,尼加拉瓜可以避免。 ”

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Cleland warns that the Nicaraguan crusade was special in many ways, and similar campaigns elsewhere might not work as well.
sentences.zh: 克莱兰警告说,尼加拉瓜的圣战在许多方面是特殊的,其他地方的类似运动可能也行不通。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: It is notoriously difficult to teach adults skills that do not have an immediate impact on their everyday lives, and many literacy campaigns in other countries have been much less successful.
sentences.zh: 众所周知,很难教授成人技能,而成人技能不会直接影响他们的日常生活,而其他国家的许多扫盲运动则远不如其他国家成功。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: ‘The crusade was part of a larger effort to bring a better life to the people,’ says Cleland.
sentences.zh: 克莱兰指出, “这场运动是为人民带来更美好生活而做出更大努力的一部分,

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Replicating these conditions in other countries will be a major challenge for development workers.
sentences.zh: 在其他国家复制这些条件将是发展工作者面临的一大挑战。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

items.prompt: The Nicaraguan National Literacy Crusade aimed to teach large numbers of illiterate… to read and write.
Public health experts have known for many years that there is a connection between child health and…
However, it has not previously been known whether these two factors were directly linked or not. This question has been investigated by… in Nicaragua.
a result, factors such as… and attitudes to children have been eliminated
And it has been shown that….. can in itself improve infant health and survival.
About a thousand of the women interviewed by the researchers had learnt to read when they were children
